title: Ticket 1.61.10 — بازگردانی استخراج محلی سخت‌افزار (R26)
notes: R26 restores local hardware extraction for the PHP host, prevents empty failed collections from being upserted, restores result/error messages, and keeps per-run network scan credentials encrypted temporarily in the user session with HTTPS required.
